facts.value: Initializes ShieldBreakFly using the configured shield_break_initial_velocity, normally the launch phase of the shield-break sequence. FTKIND_PURIN additionally sets x2222_b3. ftCo_800D3158 consumes that flag as one alternative enabling its top-blast-zone branch when the fighter is strictly above the top boundary and preceding exclusion and side-boundary checks permit reaching it. The flag does not itself change launch speed or guarantee a KO. Reflector damage-over can also reach this entry through ftCo_80098C9C, so ordinary shield depletion is not a necessary caller condition.
facts.rationale: Independently verifies the librarian's flag-consumer correction and distinguishes action identity from event provenance.

evidence.why: Configured launch and conditional flag write.
Exact flag consumer and strict boundary comparison.

facts.value: Provides the ShieldBreakFly entry path used by Fighter_ProcessHit_8006D1EC when its selected branch finds ReflectAttr.x1A3C_damageOver. It forwards the same object to ftCo_80098B20, reusing launch setup and the Fall/Down callback paths. It does not independently test shield depletion, implement later stun, or guarantee eventual landing.
facts.rationale: Actual canonical caller supports more precise provenance than the action name alone.

facts.value: Supplies shared gravity/terminal-velocity and aerial-friction processing for ShieldBreakFly. Ordinary positive finite attributes support its airborne launch trajectory, but this callback neither tests the apex nor guarantees ascent reversal before another state is selected. Animation processing can enter ShieldBreakFall; successful collision processing invokes ShieldBreakDown, not ShieldBreakFall.
facts.rationale: Repairs destination conflation and separates ordinary gameplay interpretation from unconditional behavior.

evidence.why: Separate animation, physics and collision delegation.
